name: The Interchange Off Exit 004
source:
There is an interchange that can be found somewhere along on I-9.  It isn't anything special, but it's where I find myself now. 

I'm waiting for a friend. I've asked him to take me away from here. 

To somewhere better.

[From [url=https://cybersalmon.itch.io/the-interchange-off-exit-004]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
9号州际公路沿线某处有一个立交桥。这没什么特别的，但这就是我现在发现自己的地方。

我在等一个朋友。我请求他带我离开这里。

去更好的地方。

[来自[url=https://cybersalmon.itch.io/the-interchange-off-exit-004]Itch.io[/url]]
